text:
maggie: Quick sync needed — we should agree on a tiny federated signal set for canary/AB dashboards. Runtime + infra + cost must join cleanly so product can see regressions at a glance.
sam: Yes. Key constraints: low cardinality, cheap ingest, and stable tag names.
jose: +1. propose tags: model, variant, region, route_policy, quota_tier, canary_bucket. keep it to those 6 exactly.
lee: Sounds good. On engineering join: runtime will emit `trace_id` and `req_id` where available. infra exporters can echo `trace_id` when they see network spans. fallback join window: 2s with `join_kind=fuzzy`.
maggie: We should make `join_kind` explicit so dashboards can filter fuzzy matches when doing official rollouts. Also annotate sampled traces with `sample_rate`.
anya-bot: heads-up: default trace sampling 10%. For traffic tagged `route_policy:canary` sampler bump to 25%.
sam: Metric names proposal: `runtime.token_latency_ms` (histogram -> p50/p95/p99), `runtime.kv_cache_hit_rate`, `infra.gpu_queue_ms`, `infra.gpu_util_pct`, `economics.cost_per_token_usd` (derived). All rollups: 1m/5m.
jose: On retention/TTL: raw traces 7d, metrics 90d, aggregated billing buckets 13 months. Also add a metric label `ingest_path` = runtime|infra|billing for debugging.
lee: Dashboard features: comparative panel pairs control vs candidate, show delta series with 95% CI, and an inline cost delta percentage. Add SLO overlay lines (e.g., p99 <= 250ms). Also allow toggling `join_kind=exact` only.
maggie: For alerting / regression detection: propose a lightweight realtime signal: if delta_p99 > 20% AND p99_candidate > p99_control AND p99_candidate > SLO -> fire. OR cost_delta >15% AND error_rate_increase > 2x -> fire. Keep rules parameterized.
sam: How do we compute delta? use bootstrapped CI over last 5m windows, with minimum sample count (>=100 requests) to avoid flipflop.
jose: To limit card explosion, map variant -> small set (e.g., `v1`, `v2-canary`), and truncate long model names to `model_short`. We'll document mapping in the contract.
lee: Implementation plan: 1) runtime PR to add labels + histo emission, 2) infra exporter change to echo `trace_id` and add `ingest_path`, 3) metrics federation job to join by trace_id then by window fallback, annotate `join_kind`, 4) derive `economics.cost_per_token_usd` in ETL, 5) dashboard panels + alert rules.
maggie: timeline request: can we land runtime + infra changes in 2 sprints, federation job in sprint 3, dashboards in sprint 4?
sam: Depends on infra SDK lift. I can prep the exporter patch this sprint if someone owns the federation job.
jose: i can own the federation job + derived metric ETL. will need access to metric topics and a small compute job (k8s).
lee: i'll prototype dashboard panels and share a mock. Need example query patterns from federation job.
anya-bot: deploy-bot detected a canary increase in staging earlier: routing_policy=canary traffic tag applied to test cluster.
maggie: nice. next steps: summarize contract (label names, rollups, retention, join semantics, sampling) and post here as a doc. sam/jose/lee to review. I'll file a follow-up ticket for the onboarding checklist and owners. :thumbsup:
